_comment: Bundled default banner set - offline fallback when the configured banner feed is unreachable. Each item is a same-origin HTML page under /assets/banners/ that the rotator embeds in a sandboxed <iframe>. The iframe is fluid (100% x 100%) and has its own clickable CTA link, so the banner fills the sidepanel box regardless of height. Links inside each HTML must stay on an allowed first-party host configured in banners.allowed_hosts.
